case: Optimistic grid delete refuses documents whose top-level field set changed after materialization
contract: A field added after the grid snapshot makes the keyed delete affect zero rows.
Native MongoDB verification confirms the document and the newly added value remain unchanged.
The existing stale-delete test still rejects concurrent edits, field removal and BSON NULL-to-array changes while deleting the unchanged row.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mongodb --test integration stale_grid_delete_contract -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

core_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core mongodb_delete_guards_every_non_key_value_including_null_and_missing

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-mongodb --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: ABA edits/deletes, larger-scale MongoDB full-scan performance budgets, off-page run_find type changes after census, other consumers and installed editing remain open; this focused case does not close B3.
